description: Every pension, study fund, provident fund and managers’ insurance the document tracks: the latest transcribed balance and how old it is, the management fee as stated and as measured against what was actually charged, what the dormant ones cost a year, and — the point of the feature — **whether the paychecks and the fund’s own report agree about what was deposited**. A fund finds its paycheck lines through the deduction types that pay into it — `set_deduction_types` sets that link. Name one with fund_id to also get its readings, its return window by window, and the working behind that check. Reads the document; changes nothing.

fund_id.description: Narrow to one fund and add its working — readings, returns, and the expected-versus-actual table behind the deposit verdict. Ids come from this same tool.

include_archived.description: Include archived funds. Default false. A fund can be archived with a gap still open in it, so ask for them when chasing one.

path.description: Absolute path to a .emd file on this machine.
